title: Victoria Craft Brewery Tour
includes: Beverages - 16oz total of beer tasters at each stop.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Your 3-hour Victoria Craft Brewery Tour includes samples at three breweries and round trip transportation. Led by an energetic tour guide with vast knowledge of the craft beer and wine scene, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at the local craft brewery industry. Travel in a fun group to enjoy Canadian Craft beverages.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
